title: The Detective Boys and the Ghost Mansion
notes: Detective-cast (Conan, Detective Boys) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. case_type: attempted_murder (present-day target survives because Conan secretly swapped the poison for salt before it reached the tea) plus a backstory manslaughter (Chieko's fatal wheelchair fall two months prior, caused by Hana). The old lower-fidelity `cases/ep880...json` file got the culprit right (Hideto Amemiya, confirmed by his own admission at the end and matching the transcript's motive reveal: mounting debt and desire to inherit Nobuteru's wealth), but it omitted Chieko Otaguro entirely even though her death is the seed event of the whole plot, mischaracterized Saburo Yoshimoto as an undifferentiated 'suspect' with a generic `knows` edge despite no involvement in either death, and dropped the jewelry-theft backstory that gives Hana her own motive against Chieko (Chieko had caught Hana stealing necklaces/brooches and warned her not to take more) as well as the mechanics of Hideto's manipulation (faked ghost voice via a hidden speaker/mic behind the bookcase, exploiting a coincidental lighthouse-reflection-off-a-neighboring-greenhouse illusion, plus a deliberately unlocked poison cabinet and a staged excuse to send Hana near it) that turned Hana into an unwitting weapon against Nobuteru.

clues.desc: Ghost timing exactly matches the greenhouse: sightings began the same two weeks the greenhouse was built, and the glow vanishes at 10pm, the exact time its windows close nightly -- proves the 'ghost' is reflected lighthouse light, not supernatural.

The poison cabinet was found unlocked, but a lab expert like Hideto would normally secure it, and Hana -- if she had unlocked it herself -- would have relocked it afterward to avoid discovery; the mismatch shows someone else deliberately left it open as a trap.
